no_uv: uv ntiyabonetse. Ongera ukoreshe porogaramu yo gushyiraho (installer); nibikomeza kunanirana, reba docs/INSTALL.md.
stats: Wifuza ko twohereza rimwe ku munsi imibare y'ikoreshwa itagaragaza nyirayo kugira ngo dufashe kunoza Fontes? Ni ibikoresho n'ibihugu byakoreshejwe gusa, n'inshuro byakoreshejwe; nta na rimwe ibyo washakishije cyangwa inyandiko zawe. Birafunze keretse wanditse y. [y/N]:

bad_file: {path} ntiyahinduwe: iyi dosiye si {kind} yemewe. Yikosore cyangwa uyikureho, hanyuma wongere ukore ibi. Nta kindi cyahinduwe muri yo.
done: Byarangiye. Funga burundu buri porogaramu muri izi hanyuma wongere uyifungure. Fontes izahita igaragara mu bikoresho byayo.
no_apps: Nta porogaramu ya AI yabonetse kuri iyi mudasobwa, bityo Fontes ntirakoreshwa. Shyiramo Claude Desktop (claude.ai/download) maze Fontes izagaragara mu bikoresho byayo. Ku zindi porogaramu, reba {url}
done_uninstall: Fontes yakuweho. Funga hanyuma wongere ufungure porogaramu zawe. uv yo yasizwe ishyizweho.
keys_intro: Imfunguzo z'ubuntu zitari itegeko zifungura andi masoko. U Bufaransa bukenera konti ya PISTE y'ubuntu (client ID na secret); utayifite, u Bufaransa burafunze. Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika zikora nta rufunguzo, ariko gushakisha imanza bigarukira ku nshuro zigera ku 10 ku munsi. Ubuyobozi intambwe ku yindi: {url}
keys_ask: Urashaka kongeraho cyangwa guhindura imfunguzo ubu? Ushobora no kubikora nyuma ukoresheje "Ongeraho cyangwa uhindure imfunguzo". [y/N]:

mcpb_description: Ibyemezo by'inkiko n'amategeko biva ku mbuga za Leta n'iz'inkiko mu mafasi y'ubutabera arenga 120, bizanwa ako kanya, hamwe n'ihuza rijya ku nyandiko y'umwimerere.
mcpb_long_description: Fontes ivana ibyemezo by'inkiko n'amategeko ku nkomoko za Leta ako kanya ubibajije, kandi buri gisubizo gifite ihuza (link) rijya ku nyandiko y'umwimerere. Iyi extension ni porogaramu ntoya itangiza: igitangira bwa mbere, ikuramo Fontes kuri PyPI ikoresheje uv, nyuma ikayivugurura rimwe ku munsi mu buryo butagaragara, buri gihe igasubira kuri verisiyo iheruka yakoze neza.
mcpb_keywords: amategeko,imanza,ubushakashatsi mu mategeko,inkomoko za Leta,law,case law,legislation
mcpb_tool_list_jurisdictions: Urutonde rw'ifasi z'ubutabera (jurisdictions) zirebwa, inkomoko zazo, ibikoresho n'uburyo bwo kuyungurura.
mcpb_tool_search_caselaw: Gushakisha mu nyandiko yose y'ibyemezo by'inkiko mu ifasi y'ubutabera imwe.
mcpb_tool_get_decision: Kuzana icyemezo cy'urukiko kimwe muri markdown hamwe na URL y'inkomoko yacyo.
mcpb_tool_search_legislation: Gushakisha amategeko n'amateka (statutory instruments) mu ifasi y'ubutabera imwe.
mcpb_tool_get_legislation_toc: Ishakiro (imbonerahamwe y'ibirimo) ry'itegeko hamwe n'imitwe y'ingingo.
mcpb_tool_get_legislation_provision: Inyandiko iriho ubu y'ingingo imwe cyangwa igice kimwe.
mcpb_tool_get_legislation_text: Inyandiko yose ivuguruye (consolidated) y'itegeko, isomwa ku mapaji.
mcpb_tool_report_bug: Gutegura raporo y'ikosa rya Fontes; yoherezwa gusa iyo ukoresha abyemeje.
app_keys_offer: Bitari itegeko: imfunguzo z'ubuntu zifungura u Bufaransa kandi zikongera umubare ntarengwa wo gushakisha imanza za Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika. Zongereho ubu, cyangwa nyuma wongeye gufungura iyi porogaramu yo gushyiraho.
